purpose: Supporting scenario design only; no labels and no activation evidence

scenarios.preference: Prefer demonstrated role fit over a higher grade when the target role’s core work is clearly a closer match.
scenarios.contrast: A higher grade with weaker core-role fit should rank below a lower grade with strong fit.

scenarios.preference: Give confirmed skills and experience more weight than self-declared claims.
scenarios.contrast: A declared-only match should rank below a comparable confirmed match.

scenarios.preference: Prefer relevant domain experience when the role requires domain knowledge; otherwise prefer the role’s required stack.
scenarios.contrast: Domain relevance should not outweigh a clearly required stack match without a domain requirement.

scenarios.preference: Prefer depth in the role’s essential skills over broad but shallow coverage.
scenarios.contrast: Broad coverage should win only when the role explicitly needs several distinct skill areas.

scenarios.preference: Count duration when it reflects sustained, relevant work with the required skills.
scenarios.contrast: Longer unrelated experience should not outrank shorter, directly relevant experience.

scenarios.preference: For roles requiring operational ownership, prefer production responsibility and support experience.
scenarios.contrast: For roles without that requirement, production support should not dominate role-specific delivery evidence.

scenarios.preference: Treat soft-skill evidence as a tie-breaker; preserve essential hard-skill requirements as primary.
scenarios.contrast: Strong soft skills should not compensate for a missing essential hard skill; moderate hard-skill evidence may still be outweighed by substantially stronger role evidence.

scenarios.preference: When salary fit is an explicit constraint, prefer candidates whose expectations fit the stated range, all else equal.
scenarios.contrast: A small salary mismatch should not outweigh a materially stronger role fit unless the range is a hard constraint.

review_note: Salary mismatch suggestion is not adopted: mandatory salary overlap is enforced before R0; preferences compare only eligible candidates. Operational ownership is not inferred from free text.
